title: Part Status is disabled for a user without Delete
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a second browser, or a private window, signed in at the test location as user B, whose role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' but not 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete'.
  • Have an active part, part A, at the test location.
  • Start in both browsers on the Inventory page, on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. In browser 2, as user B, type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. In browser 2, click the part A row.
  3. In browser 2, click Inactive under Part Status.
  4. In browser 2, click Cancel.
  5. In browser 1, type part A's part number in the Search box.
  6. In browser 1, click the part A row.
  7. In browser 1, click Inactive under Part Status.
  8. In browser 1, click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed in browser 2.

Step 2:

  • Part Status shows Active selected, but the choice is greyed out (disabled).

Step 3:

  • Nothing changes: Active stays selected.

Step 4:

  • The window closes.

Step 5:

  • Part A is listed in browser 1.

Step 6:

  • Part Status shows Active selected, and the choice is enabled.

Step 7:

  • For the Admin, Inactive becomes selected.

Step 8:

  • The window closes without saving, and part A stays on the Active tab.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog), story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions)

  • S13-R20: “When editing, a "Part Status" choice offers two options, Active and Inactive, set to the part's saved status. A user without the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission sees the choice disabled.”
  • S8-R6: “That user sees the Part Status choice in the part dialog disabled (S13-R20).”
